scope: Full scan of accepted verified Adverb cards found these four bare lexical-aType claims for adjective continuative forms. The scan was repeated independently; historical approvals remain unchanged.
finding: A matching inflected surface in UniDic does not by itself prove the realized pitch: lexical aType can describe basic form, and inflection modifications must be checked. All four retained primary values are positively supported by exact OJAD realized adjective ku-form cells. Three missing attested variant-1 contours are added; the fourth was already present. No primary is guessed or borrowed from a lemma.

primaryMethodSource.title: UniDic manual, printed page 23, section 6.6 and Table 9
primaryMethodSource.finding: Basic accent and inflection modifications are distinct. This manual motivates the source rule; exact modern realized contours are established separately by OJAD.
